item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. You've got a packed day — movement, reflection, check-ins, family time later on. None of that runs well if you're running dry. Dehydration shows up quietly, as fatigue, brain fog, a shorter fuse — exactly what makes staying grounded harder. Don't wait until you're thirsty to notice. Keep water within reach through the day. Action: drink a full glass of water right now, before anything else.
